# invoice-payment-reminder-automation

> Free, self-hosted Python tool that turns an invoice CSV into a daily overdue-payment reminder plan (friendly/firm/final tiers, cooldowns, aging report). Plans only; never sends.

## Key files
- iprm.py: entry point (python iprm.py demo)
- iprm_core.py: planning, tiers, aging, message rendering
- iprm_cli.py: argparse CLI (demo, plan, aging)
- example_invoices.csv / example_config.json: sample inputs (fictional data)
- test_iprm.py: unit tests (python -m unittest)
- COMPLIANCE.md: notes on payment-reminder etiquette and law
- GITHUB_METADATA.md: description and topics

## Quickstart
python iprm.py demo --messages
